text:
Maria Chen: Quick sync — planning a small microburst + tiling smoke run tonight to validate window handoff and max_tokens caps. Need someone to run loadgen and watch queueing. cc @ash @kai. PR with changes here: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/482

Ash Patel: I can run loadgen at ~11:30pm PT. Which config do you want me to use? model + quantization + concurrency?

Maria Chen: Use the `tiling-v2` branch and the `redwood-7b-q4` model variant. Suggested flags: batch window 8ms, `max_tokens` cap 1024, priority class = "small-burst". Example command I used locally:
```bash
./tools/loadgen --scenario microburst --model redwood-7b-q4 \\n  --branch tiling-v2 --batch-window-ms 8 --max-tokens 1024 \\n  --concurrency 64 --rps 1200 --duration 10m \
  --emit-metrics perf/tiling-smoke-$(date +%s).json
```
Run one warmup then the 10m run. Post the perf artifact.

Ash Patel: Got it. Any hard thresholds to auto-fail so I can abort early if needed?

Kai Nguyen: Watch for queue depth >200 or p95 latency jump >10% over baseline. Also check KV cache evictions — if eviction rate >3/s we should stop and investigate (likely bad tiling handoff). Quick grep of the metrics we care about:
```bash
jq .metrics perf/tiling-smoke-*.json | grep -E "p50|p95|p99|queue_depth|kv_evictions" -n
```
If p95 > baseline_p95 * 1.10 -> abort. Baseline p95 for this workload is ~320ms.

Jon R: Left a couple of comments on the PR about the `fallback_small_batch` gating. Main thing: ensure the fallback path retains per-client throttles. I can do a quick review after the smoke run if you want.

devex-bot: Friendly reminder: please attach the perf artifact(s) to the PR so the CI dashboard picks them up.

Ash Patel: Run completed (11:37pm–11:47pm PT). attaching perf/tiling-smoke-3501234578.json to the PR. Quick summary:
- p50: 28ms (baseline 27ms)
- p95: 340ms (baseline 320ms) -> ~6.25% regression
- p99: 780ms (baseline 720ms)
- avg queue_depth: 42 (peaks 140)
- kv_evictions: 1.2/s
Notes: saw a small compression in throughput when concurrency >64; I lowered concurrency to 48 for last 3 minutes and p95 improved slightly. No obvious OOMs or connection drops. Logs attached: `tiling-smoke-run.log`

Maria Chen: Thanks Ash — that p95 delta (6%) is within our soft threshold. Since it's <10% we can proceed with a small canary. I'll roll out tiling-v2 to 5% of traffic and monitor the dashboard for the next 2 hours. Jon, can you approve the PR so I can merge before canary?

Jon R: LGTM. Two nits in the test harness code but not blocking. Approving now :thumbsup:

sre-bot: Canary rollout scheduled: 2026-03-18T07:30:00Z -> 5% traffic, autoscale enabled, alerting on p95>baseline*1.10 and queue_depth>200. Owner: Maria Chen.

Maria Chen: I'll watch the dashboard and post an update in ~30m. If anyone wants to join the quick watch session I'll be in #eng-runtime-watch. Thanks for the quick turnaround :green_heart:
